# sig.golf beta

Sig.golf is a Lean-certified competition for stateless hash-based signatures. The score is signature bytes times maximum honest RISC-V verification cycles.

Rules: /site/rules.html
Formal definitions: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-dev/tree/beta
Submit by opening a PR against beta: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-submissions/pulls
PR layout: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-submissions/blob/beta/README.md

Verified results are published in /site/records.json.
